title: द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Amba goes to Shalva, but he refuses to take back a woman whom another man has won and carried off, telling her to return to Bhishma. Weeping, she leaves his city.
summary.kn: ಅಂಬೆ ಶಾಲ್ವನ ಬಳಿ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾಳೆ, ಆದರೆ ಬೇರೊಬ್ಬನು ಗೆದ್ದು ಒಯ್ದ ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸೆನು, ಭೀಷ್ಮನ ಬಳಿಗೇ ಹೋಗು ಎಂದು ಅವನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಳುತ್ತಾ ಅವಳು ಅವನ ನಗರ ಬಿಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: अम्बा शाल्व के पास जाती है, पर वह उस स्त्री को लेने से मना करता है जिसे किसी और ने जीतकर ले जाया हो, और उसे भीष्म के पास लौटने को कहता है। रोती हुई वह उसका नगर छोड़ देती है।
summary.te: అంబ శాల్వుని దగ్గరకు వెళ్తుంది, కానీ మరొకడు గెలిచి తీసుకువెళ్లిన స్త్రీని స్వీకరించనని, భీష్ముని దగ్గరకే వెళ్లమని అతడు నిరాకరిస్తాడు. ఏడుస్తూ ఆమె అతని నగరాన్ని విడుస్తుంది.
summary.ta: அம்பை ஶால்வனிடம் செல்கிறாள், ஆனால் வேறொருவன் வென்று கொண்டு சென்ற பெண்ணை ஏற்க மாட்டேன், பீஷ்மரிடமே திரும்பு என்று அவன் மறுக்கிறான். அழுதபடி அவள் அவன் நகரை விட்டு அகல்கிறாள்.
summary.ml: അംബ ശാല്വന്റെ അടുത്തെത്തുന്നു; എന്നാൽ മറ്റൊരാൾ ജയിച്ച് കൊണ്ടുപോയ സ്ത്രീയെ തിരിച്ചെടുക്കാൻ അദ്ദേഹം വിസമ്മതിക്കുന്നു; ഭീഷ്മരുടെ അടുത്തേക്ക് തിരികെ പോകാൻ അവളോട് പറയുന്നു. കരഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ട് അവൾ അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ നഗരം വിടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.172; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
ततोऽहं समनुज्ञाप्य कालीं सत्यवतीं तदा ।
मन्त्रिणश्च द्विजांश्चैव तथैव च पुरोहितान् ।
समनुज्ञासिषं कन्यां ज्येष्ठामम्बां नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Then I obtained the leave of Kali Satyavati, the ministers, Brahmins and priests, and gave leave to the eldest maiden, Amba, king.

verses.text:
अनुज्ञाता ययौ सा तु कन्या शाल्वपतेः पुरम् ।
वृद्धैर्द्विजातिभिर्गुप्ता धात्र्या चानुगता तदा ।
अतीत्य च तमध्वानमाससाद नराधिपम् ॥

meaning.en: With permission she went to the city of the Shalva king, guarded by aged Brahmins and followed by a nurse, and after crossing that road she reached the king.

verses.text:
सा तमासाद्य राजानं शाल्वं वचनमब्रवीत् ।
आगताहं महाबाहो त्वामुद्दिश्य महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: Reaching King Shalva, she said to him: I have come to you, mighty-armed and radiant one.

verses.text:
तामब्रवीच्छाल्वपतिः स्मयन्निव विशां पते ।
त्वयान्यपूर्वया नाहं भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि ॥

meaning.en: The king of Shalva, lord of the people, as if smiling, answered her: Fair lady, I do not want a wife who was another's first.

verses.text:
गच्छ भद्रे पुनस्तत्र सकाशं भारतस्य वै ।
नाहमिच्छामि भीष्मेण गृहीतां त्वां प्रसह्य वै ॥

meaning.en: Go back, good lady, to the Bharata; I do not want you, seized by force by Bhishma.

verses.text:
त्वं हि निर्जित्य भीष्मेण नीता प्रीतिमती तदा ।
परामृश्य महायुद्धे निर्जित्य पृथिवीपतीन् ।
नाहं त्वय्यन्यपूर्वायां भार्यार्थी वरवर्णिनि ॥

meaning.en: You were defeated and carried off by Bhishma, and you were pleased then; having been touched by him after he conquered the kings in great battle, I do not want you, fair lady, who were another's first.

verses.text:
कथमस्मद्विधो राजा परपूर्वां प्रवेशयेत् ।
नारीं विदितविज्ञानः परेषां धर्ममादिशन् ।
यथेष्टं गम्यतां भद्रे मा ते कालोऽत्यगादयम् ॥

meaning.en: How could a king like me, who knows the law and teaches others their duty, take in a woman whom another has had first? Go as you please, good lady; do not let this time pass.

verses.text:
अम्बा तमब्रवीद्राजन्ननङ्गशरपीडिता ।
मैवं वद महीपाल नैतदेवं कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Amba, tormented by the arrows of love, said to him, king: Do not speak so, lord of the earth; it is not so at all.

verses.text:
नास्मि प्रीतिमती नीता भीष्मेणामित्रकर्शन ।
बलान्नीतास्मि रुदती विद्राव्य पृथिवीपतीन् ॥

meaning.en: I was not pleased when Bhishma carried me off, destroyer of enemies; he took me by force, weeping, after driving off the kings.

verses.text:
भजस्व मां शाल्वपते भक्तां बालामनागसम् ।
भक्तानां हि परित्यागो न धर्मेषु प्रशस्यते ॥

meaning.en: Accept me, lord of Shalva, a devoted, young and blameless woman; abandoning the devoted is not praised in the laws.

verses.text:
साहमामन्त्र्य गाङ्गेयं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम् ।
अनुज्ञाता च तेनैव तवैव गृहमागता ॥

meaning.en: I took leave of Ganga's son, who never turns back in battle, and with his permission I came to your house.

verses.text:
न स भीष्मो महाबाहुर्मामिच्छति विशां पते ।
भ्रातृहेतोः समारम्भो भीष्मस्येति श्रुतं मया ॥

meaning.en: That mighty-armed Bhishma does not want me, lord of the people; I have heard that Bhishma's undertaking was for his brother's sake.

verses.text:
भगिन्यौ मम ये नीते अम्बिकाम्बालिके नृप ।
प्रादाद्विचित्रवीर्याय गाङ्गेयो हि यवीयसे ॥

meaning.en: My two sisters, Ambika and Ambalika, who were taken, Ganga's son gave to his younger brother Vichitravirya.

verses.text:
यथा शाल्वपते नान्यं नरं ध्यामि कथंचन ।
त्वामृते पुरुषव्याघ्र तथा मूर्धानमालभे ॥

meaning.en: Shalva lord, I swear I think of no other man but you, tiger among men; I touch my head in oath.

verses.text:
न चान्यपूर्वा राजेन्द्र त्वामहं समुपस्थिता ।
सत्यं ब्रवीमि शाल्वैतत्सत्येनात्मानमालभे ॥

meaning.en: I have not come to you having been another's first, king; I speak the truth, Shalva, and by truth I touch myself.

verses.text:
भजस्व मां विशालाक्ष स्वयं कन्यामुपस्थिताम् ।
अनन्यपूर्वां राजेन्द्र त्वत्प्रसादाभिकाङ्क्षिणीम् ॥

meaning.en: Accept me, wide-eyed one, a maiden who has come of herself, who was never another's first, and who hopes for your favor.

verses.text:
तामेवं भाषमाणां तु शाल्वः काशिपतेः सुताम् ।
अत्यजद्भरतश्रेष्ठ त्वचं जीर्णामिवोरगः ॥

meaning.en: As she spoke thus, Shalva abandoned the daughter of the Kashi king, best of Bharatas, as a snake sheds its old skin.

verses.text:
एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्याच्यमानस्तयानघ ।
नाश्रद्दधच्छाल्वपतिः कन्याया भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: So, though she begged him in many ways, blameless one, the Shalva king did not believe the maiden, best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततः सा मन्युनाविष्टा ज्येष्ठा काशिपतेः सुता ।
अब्रवीत्साश्रुनयना बाष्पविह्वलया गिरा ॥

meaning.en: Then the eldest daughter of the Kashi king, seized by anger, spoke, eyes full of tears, her voice choked with sobs.

verses.text:
त्वया त्यक्ता गमिष्यामि यत्र यत्र विशां पते ।
तत्र मे सन्तु गतयः सन्तः सत्यं यथाब्रुवम् ॥

meaning.en: Abandoned by you, I will go wherever I go; may the good be my refuge there, as I have spoken the truth.

verses.text:
एवं संभाषमाणां तु नृशंसः शाल्वराट्तदा ।
पर्यत्यजत कौरव्य करुणं परिदेवतीम् ॥

meaning.en: As she thus spoke, the cruel Shalva king cast her off, lamenting pitiably, Kaurava.

verses.text:
गच्छ गच्छेति तां शाल्वः पुनः पुनरभाषत ।
बिभेमि भीष्मात्सुश्रोणि त्वं च भीष्मपरिग्रहः ॥

meaning.en: Go, go, Shalva said to her again and again. I fear Bhishma, fair-hipped lady, and you are taken by Bhishma.

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता तु सा तेन शाल्वेनादीर्घदर्शिना ।
निश्चक्राम पुराद्दीना रुदती कुररी यथा ॥

meaning.en: Spoken to thus by the short-sighted Shalva, she left the city, wretched and weeping like an osprey.
